column1: # Hamzat al-qat' missing on particles, pronouns and أفعل forms.
# Matched as whole words only: after a prefix these letters collide with real
# words (كانت، كانا، بانت، لانت، والى، واو), so prefixed forms are listed
# explicitly. ان is left out (إن or أن cannot be told apart).
